text: とつぜんへんいで　みつかった　ふたつの　あたまを　もつ　ポケモン。

structure.jp: とつぜんへんいで　みつかった
ふたつの　あたまを　もつ

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ふたつの　あたまを　もつ　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing it is. ふたつの あたまを もつ ポケモン = 'a Pokémon that has two heads'.

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で here shows what brought something about. とつぜんへんいで = 'through a sudden mutation'.
